item.name: Writes the sections present in the request body to the target, merging with any existing sections not mentioned. Callers only need to include the sections they intend to set — omitted sections are preserved unchanged. To clear a section, delete the row and re-create it without that section. All section×target combinations are accepted on the backend; sections that are irrelevant to a given target are stored but have no effect at evaluation time. Requires org-level edit permission on the owning org regardless of target type.

item.name: Returns the effective policy for a target by merging the full hierarchy (org → workspace → managed_project) with strictest-wins semantics. Each field reflects the strictest value set at any level; absent fields at all levels are absent in the result. Pass `?provenance=true` to also receive `policySource`: per-field arrays of the levels that set each value, ordered strictest-first.
